summary: Lunar calendar app with detailed nakshatra/pada tracking, including interpretive descriptions of lunar climate for each pada position
architectural_notes: Pada data structure includes: nakshatra name, degree range, pada number, navamsa sign, title, and full interpretive description text
Current pada display should show real-time lunar climate interpretation based on Moon's position
Total of 108 pada descriptions spanning 27 nakshatras need to be stored/accessible

existing_features.title: Create a comprehensive pada data structure containing all 108 pada descriptions (4 padas for each of the 27 nakshatras) with the following fields: nakshatra name, pada number (1-4), degree range, navamsa sign, title, and full interpretive description text as provided by the user
Extend the nakshatraEngine utility to calculate not just the current nakshatra but also the specific pada (1-4) based on the Moon's precise degree position within the nakshatra's 13°20' range

Update the CurrentNakshatraBanner component to display the current pada information including pada number, navamsa sign, title, and full interpretive description representing the current lunar climate
Add a visual indicator or emphasis showing that the displayed pada information represents the current lunar climate and emotional atmosphere

new_feature_requests.summary: Add detailed pada descriptions to main page current pada section, representing current lunar climate with interpretive text for all 27 nakshatras (108 padas total)
